name: p2_wide
description: Rerun of the core KE-weighted (P2) GpLSI geometries on the 50-point penalty grid (to ~0.75), because lambda_wide showed P2's CV optimum (~0.12-0.21) lies far above the core grid top (~0.0165). P3 is omitted because P3 = P2 at p = 2,000 (Tran thresholding removes <= 5 genes).
